figures.caption: **Figure 1. Two directions.** A camera's video leaves your home on the upload side. The big download number on your bill says little about it.

figures.caption: **Figure 3. Same house, same doorbell.** The dashed line is the Wi-Fi path. Moving the box, or adding a unit near the front, takes walls out of the way.

figures.caption: **Figure 4. Two lanes to the door.** The 2.4 GHz lane reaches farther through walls but is busier. The 5 GHz lane carries more but gives up sooner.

figures.caption: **Figure 5. What the wire carries.** Only the one on a network cable sends its video without Wi-Fi. The other two still need a good Wi-Fi signal.
